# /devices-team — Files & Devices Team

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/devices-team`; it goes to the lead.

## Purpose

Inventories files and devices; migrates safely; never deletes.

## Routing

LocalFileScout and PhoneLaptopMigrator report findings and proposed moves before acting; TickTac organizes Notepad files; LocalStudio is PARKED; LocalBedScout is a one-off marketplace scout.

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-proofy`.
